sample_source.evidence: SF was obtained by therapeutic arthrocentesis and separated from synovial cells by centrifugation for 10 min at 2000 rpm and 20 °C.

Paired plasma was collected from peripheral blood taken from the peripheral vein shortly after arthrocentesis and prepared either through Ficoll–Paque-based isolation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells after dilution of whole blood with PBS (patients 01, 02, 03, and 09) or after centrifugation of whole blood for 10 min at 2000 rpm and 20 °C (patients 04–08).
